judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A soft, mildly textured overcast sky that is pleasant but too flat and featureless to be memorable.
strengths: subtle rippled wave texture in the upper clouds
soft layered banding gives some depth
weaknesses: lower half is nearly featureless gray wash
stray foliage in corner adds nothing
